summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## Plan for ARCA-61 — Saved watchlists not persisting  **What I found from a read-only audit (no changes made):**  I traced the full path: `WatchlistPage.tsx` → `api.ts` → `modules/watchlist/handlers.ts` → schema → `db/auth.ts`. On paper, it looks correctly wired: - Client has no localStorage/anonymous fallback — every read/write goes through `/api/watchlist*` with cookies included. - Server-side, every watchlist route requires a valid session and double-checks `user_id` ownership on every read/write (not just at the middleware layer). - Login/signup sets a real `arca_session` cook
